source: __global__ void k_scale(float alpha, const float* a, float* y, int n){int i=blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x;if(i<n)y[i]=alpha*a[i];}
__global__ void k_add(const float* a, const float* b, float* y, int n){int i=blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x;if(i<n)y[i]=a[i]+b[i];}
__global__ void k_saxpy(float alpha, const float* a, const float* y, float* z, int n){int i=blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x;if(i<n)z[i]=alpha*a[i]+y[i];}
__global__ void k_relu(const float* a, float* y, int n){int i=blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x;if(i<n)y[i]=a[i]>0.0f?a[i]:0.0f;}
__global__ void k_copy(const float* a, float* y, int n){int i=blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x;if(i<n)y[i]=a[i];}
__global__ void k_triad(float alpha, const float* a, const float* b, float* y, int n){int i=blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x;if(i<n)y[i]=alpha*a[i]+b[i];}
__global__ void k_mul(const float* a, const float* b, float* y, int n){int i=blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x;if(i<n)y[i]=a[i]*b[i];}
__global__ void k_div(const float* a, const float* b, float* y, int n){int i=blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x;if(i<n)y[i]=a[i]/b[i];}

__global__ void k_block_sum(const float* a, float* y, int n){__shared__ float s[256];int i=blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x;s[threadIdx.x]=(i<n)?a[i]:0.0f;__syncthreads();for(int k=blockDim.x/2;k>0;k>>=1){if(threadIdx.x<k)s[threadIdx.x]+=s[threadIdx.x+k];__syncthreads();}if(threadIdx.x==0)y[blockIdx.x]=s[0];}
__global__ void k_strided_read(const float* a, float* y, int n, int stride){int i=blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x;if(i<n)y[i]=a[i*stride<n?i*stride:n-1];}
__global__ void k_scatter_write(const float* a, float* y, const int* idx, int n){int i=blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x;if(i<n)y[idx[i]<n?idx[i]:n-1]=a[i];}
__global__ void k_random_access(const float* a, float* y, const unsigned int* seed, int n){int i=blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x;if(i<n){unsigned s=seed[i]*1664525u+1013904223u;y[i]=a[s%n];}}

__global__ void k_tiled_gemm(const float* A,const float* B,float* C,int D){__shared__ float As[32][32],Bs[32][32];int t=blockIdx.x*32+threadIdx.x;for(int k=0;k<32;k+=1){As[threadIdx.x][k]=A[t*32+k];Bs[threadIdx.x][k]=B[k*32+threadIdx.x];}__syncthreads();for(int k=0;k<32;k++)C[t*32+threadIdx.x]+=As[threadIdx.x][k]*Bs[threadIdx.x][k];}
__global__ void k_sub(const float* a, const float* b, float* y, int n){int i=blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x;if(i<n)y[i]=a[i]-b[i];}
__global__ void k_max(const float* a, const float* b, float* y, int n){int i=blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x;if(i<n)y[i]=a[i]>b[i]?a[i]:b[i];}
__global__ void k_min(const float* a, const float* b, float* y, int n){int i=blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x;if(i<n)y[i]=a[i]<b[i]?a[i]:b[i];}
__global__ void k_fma(const float* a, const float* b, float* y, int n){int i=blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x;if(i<n)y[i]=a[i]*b[i]+a[i];}
__global__ void k_neg(const float* a, float* y, int n){int i=blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x;if(i<n)y[i]=-a[i];}
__global__ void k_abs(const float* a, float* y, int n){int i=blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x;if(i<n)y[i]=a[i]<0.0f?-a[i]:a[i];}
__global__ void k_sqrt(const float* a, float* y, int n){int i=blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x;if(i<n)y[i]=sqrtf(a[i]);}
__global__ void k_exp(const float* a, float* y, int n){int i=blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x;if(i<n)y[i]=expf(a[i]);}
__global__ void k_sin(const float* a, float* y, int n){int i=blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x;if(i<n)y[i]=sinf(a[i]);}
__global__ void k_cos(const float* a, float* y, int n){int i=blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x;if(i<n)y[i]=cosf(a[i]);}
__global__ void k_clamp(const float* a, float lo, float hi, float* y, int n){int i=blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x;if(i<n)y[i]=a[i]<lo?lo:(a[i]>hi?hi:a[i]);}
